text: A student uses the following method to determine the percentage by mass of the painkiller aspirin,
C H O (s), in some tablets.
step 1 Grind five tablets into a powder.
step 2 Use a weighing boat to accurately weigh by difference approximately 0.4 g of powdered
tablets into a pear‑shaped flask containing anti‑bumping granules.
step 3 Add 25 cm of aqueous 1 mol dm sodium hydroxide, NaOH(aq), to the pear‑shaped
step 4 Reflux mixture A for 20 minutes.
step 5 Allow mixture A to cool and then filter into a small beaker. Label the filtrate solution B.
step 6 Add 30 cm of alkaline aqueous iodine to solution B and leave to stand for 1 hour. A
precipitate, C, (C H I O) (s), will form.
step 7 Filter the resulting mixture under reduced pressure. Wash the residue, C, with a small
step 8 Allow solid C to dry.
step 9 Weigh solid C and record its mass.
